items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I think it was Wynton Kelly was her accompanist.

ctx.x: This was during -- I'd say around in the forties, when she was really doing quite a bit of recording. And let's see, who was her accompanist? I think it was Wynton Kelly was her accompanist. And she was using Paul Quinichette quite a bit at this time. They called Paul the vice president. You know, he played so much like Prez they called him the -- Prez was the president and that was the vice prez. And I did quite a few recordings with her, and I did quite a few recordings at that time with Billy Taylor. And --…
